for entry in ledger['files']:
    path=entry['path']
    if entry['status']!='refactored' or not path.endswith('.sql'):
        continue
    before=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','252de64:'+path],text=True)
    after=pathlib.Path(path).read_text()
    assert pattern.findall(before)==pattern.findall(after),path
    print('Lexical tokens identical:',path)
